characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [cannon], [torpedoes], or [missiles] upgrade icon. Increase your hull value by 1.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: Each time you are assigned a focus or stress token, each other friendly ship with Attanni Mindlink must also be assigned the same type of token if it does not already have one.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, if you are inside the attacker's firing arc and at Range 1 and the attacker is inside your firing arc, add 1 [evade] result.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if you are inside the defender's firing arc at Range 1 and the defender is inside your firing arc, you may add 1 [hit] result to your roll.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Combat phase, if you executed a 3-, 4-, or 5-speed maneuver this round, you may rotate your mobile firing arc.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: You have the pilot ability of each other friendly ship with the IG-2000 Upgrade card (in addition to your own pilot ability).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After executing a green maneuver, you may acquire a target lock.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a turn maneuver ([left turn] or [right turn]), you may rotate your dial to the corresponding bank maneuver ([left bank] or [right bank]) of the same speed.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a red maneuver, you may assign 1 focus token to your ship.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Combat phase, when you spend a focus token, you may receive 1 stress token to assign 1 focus token to your ship.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, after you spend a focus token, you may acquire a target lock on the defender.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: When you are dealt a faceup Damage card with the Ship trait, you may immediately discard that card (before resolving its effect). Then, discard this Upgrade card.

characteristics.name: Salvaged Astromech Ability
characteristics.$text: You may treat all 3-speed maneuvers as green maneuvers.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Place 1 shield token on this card. Action: Remove 1 shield token from this card to recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, during the "Modify Attack Dice" step, you may receive 1 ion token to choose 1 of the defender's focus or evade tokens. That token cannot be spent during this attack.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After performing an attack, if the defender was dealt a faceup Damage card, you may discard this card to choose and discard 1 of the defender's Upgrade cards.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may spend a focus token to choose a friendly ship at Range 1 with higher pilot skill than you. Increase its agility value by 1 until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that does not hit, if you are not stressed, you must receive 1 stress token. Then, assign 1 focus token to your ship and acquire a target lock on the defender.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die. If the defender is a unique pilot, you may instead reroll up to 2 attack dice.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: The first time you attack each round and the first time you defend each round, the first Damage card dealt is dealt faceup.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you are destroyed, before you are removed from the play area, you may deploy the Nashtah Pup Pilot. It cannot attack this round.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: You have the pilot ability of each friendly ship with the IG-2000 Upgrade card (in addition to your own pilot ability).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the End phase, you may choose 1 enemy ship inside your firing arc at Range 1-2. That ship does not remove its tractor beam tokens.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, you may remove 1 stress token from the attacker to add 1 [evade] result to your roll.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your action bar gains the [barrel roll] action icon. You must equip 1 "Tractor Beam" Upgrade card (paying its squad point cost as normal).

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Increase your primary weapon value by 1.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that hits, if the defender is inside your mobile firing arc and at Range 1-2, you may assign the defender 1 tractor beam token.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After executing a maneuver that causes you to overlap an enemy ship, you may suffer 1 damage to perform 1 free action.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [system] and [illicit] icons.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if you are not stressed, you may receive any number of stress tokens to choose an equal number of defense dice. The defender must reroll those dice.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose a ship inside your firing arc at Range 1 and assign a tractor beam token to it. If it is a friendly ship, resolve the effect of the tractor beam token as though it were an enemy ship.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the End phase, you may spend 1 Energy to replace a faceup [crew] or [team] Upgrade card you have equipped with another Upgrade card of the same type of equal or fewer squad points.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the End phase, you may discard this card to replace a faceup [illicit] or [cargo] Upgrade card you have equipped with another Upgrade card of the same type of equal or fewer squad points.

characteristics.name: Hardpoint Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (energy): Spend 2 energy from this card to perform this attack against 1 ship (even a ship outside of your firing arc).

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains 1 additional [crew] upgrade icon and 1 additional [team] upgrade icon and loses 1 [cargo] upgrade icon.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: All Damage cards dealt to you are dealt faceup. You may treat all bank maneuvers ([left bank] or [right bank]) as green maneuvers. You cannot equip Modification upgrades.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform the recover action, gain 3 energy.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, if you have a reinforce token, you may add 1 additional [evade] result. If you do, after defending, discard your reinforce token.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you equip this card, place 1 illicit token on each [illicit] Upgrade card in your squad. When you are instructed to discard an Upgrade card, you may discard 1 illicit token on that card instead.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: The squad point cost of each of your equipped upgrades is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). You may equip up to 3 different Modification upgrades.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: You may equip up to 2 different Title upgrades. When performing a barrel roll action, you must use the [left bank 1] or [right bank 1] template instead of the [straight 1] template.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [bomb] upgrade icon. Once per round, when an enemy ship rolls attack dice due to a friendly bomb detonating, you may choose any number of [focus] and blank results. It must reroll those results.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After defending, if the attacker is inside your bullseye firing arc, it receives 1 stress token.
